design: Second iteration intended to reduce the cost of the separating family. Fixed before viewing the new external comparison scores. Run both schedules on every one of the 42 PMLB folds. The two schedules may return different locally irreducible supports.
full: Existing completely separating masks checked inside each deletion proposal, short-circuit on first veto.
working: Start with the empty restoration. Run the same entire block and singleton search from the same original anchor, using the currently active restorations. Test the final support against the full ordered family. If a missing context vetoes, add the first such context and restart from the original anchor. Cache score vectors throughout a schedule. Stop when the final support passes the full family.
unit: Report all 14 named tasks, 3 folds, equal task weighting of mask counts, timing, support equality, size and predictive differences. Descriptive secondary study. Timing arms run sequentially within the same process with order alternating by task and fold, separate empty caches. Contexts/row panels, predictor and anchor identical for both schedules. Shared preparation/refit overhead reported separately; totals are in-process.
verification: Verify both supports with an independent eager check of every full-family context and every eligible singleton deletion; exclude verification queries from selector timing. Baseline full schedule must recover stored antichain supports and original masked-query count; check stored predictions against newly refitted predictions. Never select the better run on the outer fold.
budget: One hour per dataset-fold. Store frozen supports, traces, selector time, actual distinct masks, restart count, held-out predictions. Retain any failure and report the coverage.
